thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU pool us-east-1 (pool-gpu-a) at 100% capacity, queue depth > 1200, 95th latency > 5s. Autoscaler failure: scale_attempts=5, last_error=\"scale-up rejected: provider quota\".
jamie_oncall: I'm on it. gathering current tail metrics and active tenants.
jamie_oncall: quick check - `/api/metrics?pool=pool-gpu-a&window=5m` shows 1200 queued, token_rate up 3x.
sre_lead_kevin: pinging autoscaler logs, might be hitting scale limits or a bug in node provisioning. tagging infra.
infra_ryan: looking. provider returned 403 for new-instance request: "QuotaExceeded.GlobalGPUs". submitted emergency quota request 10m ago, not approved yet.
support_anna: Support: two high-value customers (acme_co, searchly) reporting timeouts. estimated affected requests ~18k in last 30m. customers notified via status.redwood.ai/incidents/...? (draft)
maya_prodeng: can we short-circuit by routing non-critical traffic to CPU pool or a smaller quantized model?
jamie_oncall: yes, plan A: enable fallback-model-route for tenant tier=enterprise-> smaller variant `redwood/gptq-13b-q4` (lower throughput but less GPU mem). Plan B: shed best-effort tenants by rate-limit.
kevin: agree. patching routing policy now. applying canary to 5% first.
jamie_oncall: command I ran: ```json
{"route": "gpu->fallback-q4", "selector": "tier:enterprise", "percent": 5}
```
infra_ryan: provider escalated quota review to sync with sales. ETA > 45m. can't rely on immediate quota bump.
sre_lead_kevin: autoscaler logs excerpt: ```
[12:01:02] scaleAttempt id=abc123 -> request_instances=8
[12:01:03] provider error 403 QuotaExceeded.GlobalGPUs
[12:02:10] scaleAttempt id=abc124 -> backoff
```
jamie_oncall: temporarily increasing eviction aggressiveness for best-effort pools, TTL=120s. will reduce queue.
support_anna: updating incident channel for customers: note that enterprise customers have failover enabled, best-effort may see degraded perf. drafting message for acme_co.
maya_prodeng: also enabling prefix KV cache bypass for quiet tenants to reduce token regen. small perf win.
jamie_oncall: after routing canary to 5%, queue depth reduced to 820 in 4m. latency 95th to 3.2s. progress.
kevin: good. start gradual rollout to 35% -> 100% if stable. keep monitoring for error spikes.
infra_ryan: starting a manual warm pool on spare hosts we have in eu-west-1 but cross-region latency might affect some sessions. considering move only for queued non-affinity requests.
jamie_oncall: decision: 1) full rollout of fallback route, 2) aggressive eviction of best-effort, 3) open incident bridge if customer impact rises.
incident-bot: Bridge created: https://zoom.redwood.ai/bridge/6222223333 (joined by oncall, infra, support).
support_anna: acme_co on call, they saw request failures at 12:04-12:18. they want ETA for full restoration.
kevin: ETA depends on rollback completion and rollout %; aiming for 20-30m to full mitigation via routing.
jamie_oncall: rolling to 35% now -> metrics: queued 450 -> 260 over 12m. 95th latency 1.8s.
infra_ryan: prepping emergency provider quota docs for postmortem. also requesting internal playbook update: auto-fallback when quota errors seen.
maya_prodeng: capturing example request ids for regressions, saving prompt sets for eval.
jamie_oncall: post-incident actions I propose: - add quota-aware autoscaler path: if provider 403 QuotaExceeded then follow fallback routing automatically - run a chaos test to simulate provider quota rejection and ensure routing behaves - increase monitoring for queued requests per-tenant and auto-shed thresholds - escalate permanent quota increase for critical pools with finance ok - add runbook entry: who to call at cloud provider for quota blitz.
kevin: +1. also add unit for better error telemetry in autoscaler to pinpoint which tenant triggered the request.
support_anna: will follow up with affected customers with timeline + compensation draft.
jamie_oncall: last check: last_message_ts=6222223600, queue at 180, latency nominal, closing pager to status=mitigated. leaving the bridge open for 1h for monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to S2. Recording timeline for postmortem.
kevin: assigning owners for action items: autoscaler fallback - kevin, quota escalation playbook - ryan, customer comms - anna, chaos test - maya, monitoring alerts - jamie.
jamie_oncall: thanks team. will create postmortem draft in #postmortems and link here. :thumbsup:
support_anna: saved customer logs and request traces to ticket RED-11234.
infra_ryan: filing cloud provider follow-up ticket with request id: cpq-7890.
maya_prodeng: leaving a note to add fallback model variants to model catalog UI so product teams can opt-in ahead of time.
jamie_oncall: closing thread; moving to postmortem phase.
